selectionEntries.name: (15) MYSTIC WAKANDAN HERBS: FACT OR FICTION? {Banned - Standard}

profiles.name: (15) MYSTIC WAKANDAN HERBS: FACT OR FICTION?

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place two Herb (Asset) onto the central points on map A. Place two Vessels (Target of Opportunity) on the other two points.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 4 VPs if an allied character is holding their Herb while contesting their Vessel during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Herb): Pick up your Herb.
A character holding an Herb cannot perform more than one move action per turn, and adds one die to {PHYS} attack rolls, and has the {INNATE} Immunity [Slow, Stagger] superpower.
Herbs placed farthest from a player's board edge and Vessels placed closest to a player's board edge are their Herbs and Vessels.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 1 Researcher token (Civilian) and 2 Evac Point tokens (Asset) as shown on Map E.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: A player scores 2 VPs if they are securing the Researcher during the Cleanup Phase. Then they score 1 additional VP if the Researcher is within {RNG} 1 of their Evac Point.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, the Researcher may move. If a player is securing the Researcher, they may Place it within {RNG} 2 of its current location.

The Evac Point farthest from a player’s battlefield edge is their Evac Point.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Disturbance tokens (Asset) as shown on Map K.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Disturbance a character they control is holding during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Disturbance): Pick up this Disturbance. A character can hold only 1 Disturbance at a time.

When a character picks up a Disturbance, if there is not another allied character within {RNG} 2 of it, it suffers 1 {DMG}.

During the Cleanup Phase, if one or more characters holding a Disturbance are within {RNG} 2 of another allied character, those characters’ controlling player scores 1 VP.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Power Core tokens (Asset) as shown on Map C.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each character they control that is holding a Power Core during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Power Core): Pick up this Power Core. A character can hold only 1 Power Core at a time.

During the Cleanup Phase, each character with 3 or more {PWR} holding a Power Core rolls 3 dice. For each {FAIL} and {WILD} in the result, the character holding the Power Core and all characters within {RNG} 2 of it suffer 1 {DMG}.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 5 Spider-Infected tokens (Civilian) as shown on Map F.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Spider-Infected held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Spider-Infected): Pick up this SpiderInfected. A character can hold only 1 Spider-Infected at a time.

During the Power Phase, starting with the player with Priority, players roll 1 die for each character they control holding a Spider-Infected. If the result is a {CRIT}, {WILD}, or {HIT}, that character Advances {S} before rolling for the next character. The opposing player resolves this Advance.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 5 Cosmic Cube Fragment tokens (Asset) as shown on Map F.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Cosmic Cube Fragment held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Cosmic Cube Fragment): Pick up this Cosmic Cube Fragment.

During the Cleanup Phase, each character suffers 1 {DMG} for each Cosmic Cube Fragment it is holding. Characters gain 1 {PWR} for each {DMG} they suffered this way.

selectionEntries.name: (18) FEAR GRIPS WORLD AS "WORTHY" TERRORIZE CITIES

profiles.name: (18) FEAR GRIPS WORLD AS "WORTHY" TERRORIZE CITIES

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Celestial Hammer tokens (Asset) as shown on Map D.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Celestial Hammer held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Celestial Hammer): Pick up this Celestial Hammer.

Characters add 1 die to their attack rolls for each Celestial Hammer they are holding. Characters holding one or more Celestial Hammers must pay
1 {PWR} before playing a Team Tactic Card.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Spellbook tokens (Asset) as shown on Map E.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Spellbook held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Spellbook): Pick up this Spellbook. A character can hold only 1 Spellbook at a time.

A character holding a Spellbook may use the following attack once per turn. It cannot add additional dice to this attack or modify its dice during this attack.

{MYST} MYSTIC BEAM {RNG} B3 {STR} 6 {COST} 0

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Legacy Cure tokens (Asset) as shown on Map C.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Legacy Cure held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Legacy Cure): Pick up this Legacy Cure. A character must spend 1 {PWR} per Legacy Cure it is holding before using this Interact.

During the Cleanup Phase, if a non-Grunt character is holding all 3 Legacy Cures, its controlling player does not score VPs from this Crisis as normal. Instead, remove all Legacy Cures from the game. Then the character is KO’d and its controlling player scores 6 VPs.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 6 Senator tokens (Civilian) as shown on Map L.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP per character they control holding a Senator during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Senator): Pick up this Senator. A character can hold only 1 Senator at a time.

A character holding a Senator can make only 1 move action per turn.

selectionEntries.name: (19) PANIC GRIPS CITY AS EVACUATION EFFORTS CONTINUE! {Banned - Standard}

profiles.name: (19) PANIC GRIPS CITY AS EVACUATION EFFORTS CONTINUE!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place four Citizens (Civilian tokens) as indicated on map B.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Citizen held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Citizen): Pick up a Citizen.
A character cannot hold more than one Citizen.
During its activation, a character holding a Citizen may evacuate the Citizen by spending 6 {PWR}. The character's controlling player immediately scores 2 VPs and removes the Citizen held by that character from the game.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Skrull Agent tokens (Civilian) as shown on Map J.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Skrull Agent held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Interact (Skrull Agent): Pick up this Skrull Agent. A character can hold only 1 Skrull Agent at a time. Then roll dice equal to this character’s {PHYS} defense. If the result does not contain one or more {CRIT} or {WILD} results, the opposing player Pushes this character {S}.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Gamma Shelter tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map E.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for Securing their Close, 1 VP for the Mid, and 2 VPs for Securing their Far Gamma Shelter during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
During the Cleanup Phase, each character that is not within {RNG} 2 of a Gamma Shelter suffers 1 {DMG}.

The Gamma Shelter closest to a player’s battlefield edge is their Close Shelter. The Gamma Shelter in the center is both players’ Mid Shelter. The Gamma Shelter farthest from a player’s battlefield edge is their Far Shelter.

selectionEntries.name: (15) S.W.O.R.D. ESTABLISHES BASE ON MOON'S BLUE AREA

profiles.name: (15) S.W.O.R.D. ESTABLISHES BASE ON MOON'S BLUE AREA

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Console tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map G.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Console they Control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Console): If no enemy characters are Contesting this Console, this character’s controlling player now Controls this Console. Otherwise roll 1 die. If the result is a {CRIT}, {WILD}, or {HIT}, this character’s controlling player now Controls this Console.

During the Power Phase, if a player Controls more Consoles than their opponent, they command the base’s security system and may choose an enemy character. The chosen character is Pushed {S}. The opposing player resolves this Push.

selectionEntries.name: (16) COSMIC INVASION! BLACK ORDER DESCENDS ON EARTH

profiles.name: (16) COSMIC INVASION! BLACK ORDER DESCENDS ON EARTH

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Cosmic Vault tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map D.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Cosmic Vault they are Securing during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: During the Power Phase, some Cosmic Vaults will radiate cosmic energy. Starting with the player with Priority, players roll 1 die for each character they control within {RNG} 1 of a Cosmic Vault. If the result is a {CRIT} or {WILD}, that character gains 2 {PWR} and is Pushed {S}. The opposing player resolves this Push.

selectionEntries.name: (16) MAYOR FISK VOWS TO FIND MISSING WITNESSES

profiles.name: (16) MAYOR FISK VOWS TO FIND MISSING WITNESSES

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 2 Witness tokens (Target of Opportunity) as shown on Map H.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 2 VPs for each Witness they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
During the Cleanup Phase, each of the Witnesses may flee. Starting with the player with priority, each player Places all Witnesses Secured by their opponent within {RNG} 2 of their current position. Each Witness may be Placed this way only once per Round.

After a Witness is Placed, each character within {RNG} 1 of it suffers 1 {DMG} and gains the Stun special condition.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Origin Bomb tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map I.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Origin Bomb they Control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Interact (Origin Bomb): Roll dice equal to this character’s {ENRG} Defense. If the roll contains more {CRIT}, {WILD}, and {HIT} results than the number of Healthy enemy characters Contesting this Origin Bomb, this character’s controlling player now Controls this Origin Bomb. If the roll contains at least 1 {FAIL}, this character suffers 1 {DMG}.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Serum Canister tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map B.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Serum Canister they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: During the Power Phase, characters Contesting a Serum Canister gain 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Extremis Console tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map D.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Extremis Console they Control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Interact (Extremis Console): Remove 1 {DMG} from a non-Dazed character within {RNG} 2 of this Extremis Console.

selectionEntries.name: (18) MUTANT MADMAN TURNS CITY CENTER INTO LETHAL AMUSEMENT PARK

profiles.name: (18) MUTANT MADMAN TURNS CITY CENTER INTO LETHAL AMUSEMENT PARK

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Trap tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map B.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Trap they are Controlling during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Interact (Trap): Roll dice equal to this character’s {PHYS} Defense. If the roll contains more {CRIT}, {HIT}, and {WILD} results than the number of Healthy enemy characters Contesting this Trap, this character’s controlling player now Controls this Trap.

During the Cleanup Phase, each player Controlling a Trap chooses an enemy character within {RNG} 2 of each Trap they Control. The chosen character suffers 1 {DMG} and gains 1 {PWR}. Resolve each Trap completely before resolving the next.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 4 Inheritor Portals (Point of Interest) as shown on Map D.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Inheritor Portal they Control during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Interact (Inheritor Portal): Roll dice equal to this character’s {ENRG} Defense. If the roll contains more {CRIT}, {HIT}, and {WILD} results than the number of Healthy enemy characters Contesting this Inheritor Portal, this character’s controlling player now Controls this Inheritor Portal. If the roll contains at least 1 {FAIL}, this character is Placed within {RNG} 2 of its current position. The opposing player resolves this Place.
