profiles.name: (19) DEMONS DOWNTOWN! HAS OUR COMEUPPANCE COME DUE?

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Flaming Portal tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map E.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Flaming Portal they are Securing during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: During the Power Phase, characters within {RNG} 1 of a Flaming Portal gain the Incinerate special condition.

selectionEntries.name: (19) INTRUSIONS OPEN ACROSS CITY AS SEALS COLLAPSE

profiles.name: (19) INTRUSIONS OPEN ACROSS CITY AS SEALS COLLAPSE

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 3 Dark Portal tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map C.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Dark Portal they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Interact (Dark Portal): This character drops all objective tokens it is holding. Then roll 1 die. If the result is a {CRIT}, {WILD}, {HIT}, or {BLOCK}, Place this character within {RNG} 1 of another Dark Portal. Otherwise, the opposing player Places this character within {RNG} 1 of another Dark Portal.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place 5 Ambush tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on Map F.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 1 VP for each Ambush they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Characters Contesting an Ambush have Cover from characters not Contesting the same Ambush.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: Place two Terrigen Mist Clouds (Target of Opportunity) on the points near each board edge as shown on map C.

characteristics.name: Scoring
characteristics.$text: Players score 2 VPs for each Mist Cloud they are securing during the Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: During the Cleanup Phase, each of the Mist Clouds may move. Starting with the player with priority, each player places all Mist Clouds secured by their opponent within {RNG} 2 of their current position. Each token may be placed only once per round in this way. Then each character within {RNG} 1 of a Mist Cloud suffers 1 {DMG} and gains the Poison special condition.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: With enough time, the regeneration tanks of the Celestials can cure even the most virulent diseases and grievous wounds.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, Place 2 or more Regeneration Tanks onto open spaces on the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Interact (Regeneration Tank): Remove up to 2 {DMG} and up to 1 special condition from this character. Then, this character gains the Stagger special condition.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When Dormammu walks the Earth he brings the power of the Dark Dimension with him.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Dark Intrusions on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: The Power of the Dark Dimension: While a character is within {RNG} 2 of a Dark Intrusion it may count 1 {FAIL} as a success when attacking, defending, or dodging.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The towns surrounding Dracula's Crypt live in a perpetual twilight. As one approaches his tomb, an unnatural darkness descends.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, Place the Tomb of Dracula onto an open space on the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Unnatural Darkness: All characters gain the Stealth {INNATE} superpower.

{INNATE} Stealth
Characters must be within {RNG} 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The trench line is moving forward, bring additional emplacements!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Hydra Turrets on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Fire!: Any character may Interact with the Hydra Turret terrain feature as if it was an objective token.

Interact (Hydra Turret): Choose an enemy character not within {RNG} 2 of the Hydra Turret and within LOS of the interacting character. Roll 5 attack dice. For each {CRIT}, {WILD}, and {HIT} in the roll, the chosen enemy character suffers 1 {DMG}.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Dracula employs lesser thralls to guard his tomb. Even superheroes should not tread there lightly.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If there is not already a Size 5 terrain feature on the battlefield, Place a Size 5 terrain feature onto an open space on the battlefield. Then, choose a Size 5 terrain feature on the battlefield, it is now a non-interactive terrain feature. Place 3 Thrall tokens within {RNG} 2 of the chosen terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Lesser Thralls: When a non-Thralls of Dracula character ends a movement within {RNG} 2 of a Thrall token, roll dice equal to that character's {PHYS} defense. If the result does not contain one or more {CRIT} or {WILD} results, the character is dealt 1 {DMG}, gains 1 {PWR}, and gains the Bleed special condition.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The heroes sneak through the crowded streets, hidden in the crowd by the strobe and flash of color from nearby signage.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Cosmic Sign Posts on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Distracting Advertisement: When a character within {RNG} 2 is defending, it must reroll 1 {BLOCK} result in its defense roll, if able.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The previous battle knocked loose some machinery that is now... floating away? Should it be doing that?

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Untethered Nodes on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Gravitational Distortions: While a character is within {RNG} 2 of an Untethered Node, when determining if it can be Thrown or Pushed by an effect or special rule, the character counts as one size lower.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Get in, we’re going for a ride!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Cars on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
We Need To Borrow Your Vehicle: A character of Size 3 or less may interact with a Car as if it was an objective token.

Interact (Car): Place the {L} movement tool in contact with one of the front wheels of the car, extending from the front of the vehicle. Bend the knuckle however you like. The movement tool may not overlap any terrain features of an equal or larger size than the Car. Each overlapped character suffers 1 {DMG}. Then, place the Car terrain feature with one of its back wheels in contact with the end of the movement tool, extending from the back of the vehicle, and not overlapping any other terrain feature or character. Then place the interacting character within {RNG} 1 of the Car.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A vampire hunter has tracked Dracula to his crypt, will the brave warrior rid the world of the vampiric menace?

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If Dracula is part of either player's roster, this card may be used. If not already on the battlefield, Place the Tomb of Dracula onto an open space on the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Dracula's Estate: During the first Power Phase, Dracula gains 2 additional {PWR}.

I Know You're Here: After Dracula deploys, the opposing player deploys an unused character from their roster with Threat Value 3 or less as part of their Squad. This character is the Vampire Hunter.

Out for Blood: When the Vampire Hunter makes an Advance, it must Advance Toward Dracula.

Many Have Tried, All Have Failed: While Dracula is within {RNG} 3 of the Vampire Hunter, he may spend 8 {PWR}. If he does, the Vampire Hnter is removed from the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: People will throw away literally anything.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Dumpsters on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
One Man’s Trash: A character may interact with a Dumpster as if it was an objective token.

Interact (Dumpster): Roll 3 dice. Consult the below chart for each result. Resolve the results from top to bottom:
- {CRIT} or {WILD} Discarded Suit: The interacting character gains 1 {PWR}.
- {HIT} Warm Shawarma: The interacting character removes 1 {DMG}.
- {BLOCK} and {BLANK} What Even Is That...: No effect.
- {FAIL} Angry Opossum: The interacting character suffers 1 {DMG} and gains 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Everyone could use a little help every once in a while.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one Nelson and Murdock Apartment Building on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Pro Bono: While a character within {RNG} 2 of the Nelson and Murdock Apartment Building that is controlled by the player with the least (or tied for least) VPs is defending against an attack or dodging, they may reroll one of their defense or dodge dice.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one Sanctum Sanctorum on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Powers Not To Be Trifled With: When a character is targeted by an attack while within {RNG} 2 of the Sanctum Sanctorum it may spend 2 {PWR}. If it does, it may use its {MYST} Defense regardless of the attack’s type.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: I can never tell when S.H.I.E.L.D. is going to show up... But I’m always glad when they do!

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Reinforcements: If the Quinjet is not on the battlefield, after VPs are scored during the End Phase, the player with the least VPs rolls dice equal to the difference between their VPs and the player with the most VPs. If there is a tie for least VPs, no dice are rolled. If there is a {CRIT} in the results, shuffle all unused character cards from the losing player's roster together and pick one at random. The losing player places the Quinjet on the battlefield not overlapping any Size 3 or larger terrain and not overlapping any characters. Any Size 1 or Size 2 terrain it would overlap is destroyed. Then, place the randomly selected character within {RNG} 1 of the Quinjet. It is part of the losing player's Squad.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Who knows what manner of goop could be contained in such a truck... Let’s throw it at them and find out!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Oscorp Chemical Trucks on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: What Even Is This Stuff?: When an Oscorp Chemical Truck is thrown, if it collides with a character, that character rolls dice equal to their {ENRG} Defense instead of {PHYS} Defense when they are dodging that collision. If the character suffers {DMG} from this collision, it gains the Poison special condition.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Lesser beings are clay to be molded by the hands of the Celestials. All those who fear change dread their grasp.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, Place the Rejuvenation Chamber onto an open space on the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Transformation: At the start of an allied character's Activation, if that character is Injured and is overlapping the Rejuvenation Chamber, it may be KO'd. If a character is KO'd in this way, Place an unused character from your roster with a Threat Value equal to or lower than the Threat Value of the KO'd character into play overlapping the Rejuvenation Chamber. The unused character gains 3 {PWR} and an Activated token and is now part of your Squad.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: How do they always know things before we do?

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Daily Bugle Stands on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: New York’s Finest Newspaper: While a character is within {RNG} 1 of a Daily Bugle Stand it may reroll 1 of its defense or dodge dice.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Sound of combat fills the air! The heroes of this battlefield are impelled toward glory by memories of the honored dead and the Warrior's vigilant eyes.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place the Asgardian Shrine onto the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Blessings of the Aesir: Each time a character within {RNG} 2 of the Asgardian Shrine rolls dice as part of an attack, defense, or dodge, if the roll contains one or more {BLOCK} results, after the effect is resolved, that character gains 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Let’s see if they can break through THIS!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Cement Mixers on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Concrete Shoes: When a Cement Mixer is Thrown, if it collides with a character, if the character suffers {DMG} from this collision, it gains the Slow special condition.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: No fights in the bar, get outta here...

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one Josie’s Bar Apartment Building on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Keep It Clean: While a character within {RNG} 2 of the Josie’s Bar Apartment Building that is controlled by the player with the least (or tied for least) VPs is attacking, they may reroll one of their attack dice.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: As you approach, the crystal obelisk begins to glow. In the light, you see glimpses of far off destinations. When you concentrate on holding one of the images in your mind, you suddenly find yourself there in the flesh.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, Place 2 or more Crystal Obelisks onto open spaces on the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Interact (Crystal Obelisk): Place this character within {RNG} 1 of another Crystal Obelisk.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This city runs on coffee and donuts... I see no reason why we shouldn’t!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Daily Grind Coffee Stands on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Caffeine and Carbs: During each Power Phase, each player chooses one allied character within {RNG} 1 of a Daily Grind Coffee Stand. Each chosen character gains 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The beacons are ablaze! Heroes rush to join the fray when the call for aid is shone. A great battle is upon them!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place two or more Beacon of Heroes on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Characters within {RNG} 3 of the Beacon of Heroes do not benefit from the Stealth {INNATE} superpower.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: As combatants slam into the dirt, their weary eyes re-focus onto the majestic panther statue keeping solemn vigil. Was that there before...?

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one or more Small Panther Statues on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Eyes of the Gods: While within {RNG} 3 and LOS of a Panther Statue, when a character suffers {DMG}, it gains 1 additional {PWR}.

On the Prowl: When a character would become Dazed or KO'd, before it is removed from the battlefield, its controlling player may Place one of the Panther Statues within {RNG} 2 of the Dazed or KO'd character. This special rule may place a Panther Statue that has been removed from the battlefield back onto the battlefield. Then the character is Dazed or KO'd.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one Ultron Bot Infested Building on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Scrabbling Claws: When a character ends a movement within {RNG} 1 of an Ultron Bot Infested Building, after the effect is resolved, it gains the Bleed special condition.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Followers of Apocalypse visit his shrines to test their resolve. Atop this edifice, follwers undergo near fatal tests of endurance to push their limits and come out stronger.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, Place the Shrine to En Sabah Nur onto an open space on the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Survival is Strength: When a character that is overlapping the Shrine to En Sabah Nur suffers {DMG}, after the effect is resolved, it may remove 1 {DMG} from itself.

Ancient Monument: The Shrine to En Sabah Nur is a Size 4 non-interactive terrain feature during this Mission.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Hydra has created a machine that can harness the power of the Sun!

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one Hydra Generator on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Interact (Hydra Generator): This Interacting character may spend any amount of {PWR} to use this Interact. Roll 10 dice, reducing the number of dice rolled by the amount of {PWR} spent to use this Interact. For each {CRIT}, {WILD}, and {HIT} in the roll, this Interacting character suffers 1 {DMG}. If this character is not Dazed or KO’d by this effect, it does not gain an activated token at the end of this activation and the Hydra Generator is destroyed. If this character would be Dazed, it is Pushed {M} Away from the Hydra Generator, then it is Dazed.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: With the squeal of tires and telltale clang of hollow metal, the Vibranium Hauler is derailed from its course. As its unstable contents spill across the road, the gleam of an idea passes through the combatants. Stealing the malformed canisters is too obvious. But returning them might well curry favor with the powerful Wakanda...

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place the Vibranium Hauler and all 6 Vibranium Canisters onto the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Unyielding Alloy: The Vibranium Hauler is not destroyed when it is Thrown or collided with by characters and terrain features. Instead, after the collision is resolved, Place the Vibranium Hauler within {RNG} 1 of the character or terrain feature it collided with. The player that caused the effect resolves this Place.

Unstable Vibranium: A character holding at least one Vibranium Canister loses 1 {PWR} per Vibranium Canister it is holding during the Power Phase.

Interact (Vibranium Canister): This character picks up this Vibranium Canister and places it on its Stat Card. This character is now holding this Vibranium Canister.

Interact (Vibranium Hauler): Remove all Vibranium Canisters this character is holding from its Stat Card. This character adds 1 die to its attack rolls this Round per Canister removed this way.

characteristics.name: Setup
characteristics.$text: If not already on the battlefield, place one Weapon X Bunker on the battlefield not within {RNG} 2 of another terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Weapon X-Periments: All characters without the Healing Factor [X] {INNATE} superpower gain the Healing Factor [1] {INNATE} superpower.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The assigned character gains the following superpowers:

{ACTIVE} CREATED TO END {COST} 3
During the next attack this character makes this Turn, add 1 die to the attack roll for each {DMG} the target character has, to a maximum of 3. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

{INNATE} HORSEMAN OF DEATH
Once per Turn, when another character is Dazed or KO'd by this character or this character is Dazed or KO'd, after the effect is resolved, Master of the Horsemen gains 3 Evolution tokens.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The assigned character gains the following superpowers:

{ACTIVE} VANISH INTO DUST {COST} 2
Choose up to one enemy character within {RNG} 2 of this character. If an enemy character is chosen this way, it loses 1 {PWR}.

Place this character within {RNG} 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

{INNATE} HORSEMAN OF FAMINE
At the end of this character's Activation, if no non-Dazed enemy characters are within {RNG} 3 of it, Master of the Horsemen gains 1 Evolution token.

sharedSelectionEntries.name: HORSEMEN CARD - MASTER OF THE HORSEMEN

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Once per Turn during his Activation, Apocalypse may use 1 of the {ACTIVE} superpowers on any Horsemen Card that was assigned to an allied character by the Apocalypse's Horsemen Leadership.

When Apocalypse is KO'd, this card is removed from play after the effect is resolved.

During the Power Phase, this card gains 1 Evolution token.

This card can have a maximum of 6 Evolution tokens on it.

Once per Turn, while an allied character assigned a Horsemen Card is attacking, defending, or dodging, during the Modify Dice step, it may remove up to 3 Evolution tokens from this card. For each Evolution token removed by a character in this way, that character may reroll one of its dice.

An allied character assigned a Horsemen Card may spend Evolution tokens on this card as if they were {PWR} on its Stat Card to pay the {PWR} cost of superpowers on Horsemen Cards.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The assigned character gains the following superpowers:

{ACTIVE} CONSUMING BLIGHT {COST} 2
For each enemy character within {RNG} 2, choose one of the following effects:
- If that character has the Poison, Root, or Slow special conditions, it suffers 1 {DMG}.
- That character gains one of the following special conditions: Poison, Root, or Slow.
This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

{INNATE} HORSEMAN OF PESTILENCE
At the end of this character's Activation, Master of the Horsemen gains 1 Evolution token for each enemy character that gained one or more special conditions during this character's Activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The assigned character gains the following superpowers:

{ACTIVE} FURY {COST} 2
During the next attack made by this character this Turn, if the target character is within {RNG} 2, this character may change 1 die result to a {HIT} for each {CRIT} or {WILD} in the attack roll.

{INNATE} HORSEMAN OF WAR
The first time each Turn this character suffers {DMG} from an enemy effect and the first time each Turn this character deals {DMG}, after the effect is resolved, Master of the Horsemen gains 1 Evolution token.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Choose an Enemy within {RNG} 3 and advance it {S}. This superpower may be used only once per turn.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: During the Power Phase, this character gains 2 additional {PWR} instead of the normal 1 for having this Infinity Gem.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: When rolling dice as part of an attack, defense, dodge, or interact roll, this character treats one {FAIL} result as a {CRIT} result.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: When an enemy character within {RNG} 4 of this character uses an {ACTIVE} or {REACTIVE} superpower this character gains 1 {PWR} after the effect is resolved.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Choose this character or another allied character within {RNG} 3 and place it within {RNG} 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: When this character is attacking, before the Calculate success or failure step, at the end of the Modify Dice step of the attack, it may use this superpower. The attacking and defending characters reroll all of their attack and defense dice, including {FAIL} results.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character suffers 1 damage {DMG} at the end of each of its activations.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character doesn't roll additional dice for its critical {CRIT} results during attack, defense or dodge rolls.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character removes one die from its defense rolls.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character does not gain power when suffering damage from enemy attacks.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character loses 1 Power {PWR} during the Power Phase.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character must spend 1 {PWR} before using an {ACTIVE} or {REACTIVE} superpower.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character removes one die from its attack rolls.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: The character can only use the Short {S} movement tool while advancing.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: When the character activates its first action must be a Shake action. This Shake action must remove the Stagger special condition.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: If an effect would cause the character to gain more than 1 Power {PWR}, it gains only 1 Power {PWR} instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Fluppy (Damage Control Bulldog) card Set symbol.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
An A-Force character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
When an allied character is defending against an attack this round, add 1 die to the defense roll for each other allied A-Force character within {RNG} 2 of that character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied A-Force character with Flight begins a move action within {RNG} 2 of an allied She-Hulk during its activation, they may spend 1 {PWR} each to play this card before moving the miniature.
When the active character ends this move, place She-Hulk within {RNG} 1 of it. She-Hulk may immediately perform one of her attacks that has a listed {PWR} cost of 0.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, any number of allied A-Force characters may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} to play this card cannot be Pushed or Thrown by enemy effects this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the activation phase, an allied Asgard character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
This character cannot roll defense dice against {PHYS} attacks for the rest of the game. Additionally, this character adds dice to its {PHYS} attacks equal to its {PHYS} defense until the next Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
{INNATE} THOR'S BLESSING
This character adds 1 die to its attack rolls.
Additionally, after this character makes an attack, if it dealt {DMG}, the target character gains the Shock special condition.


During Thor, Hero of Midgard's Activation, he may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
For the rest of this Round, while other allied characters are within {RNG} 4 of Thor, Hero of Midgard, they have the Thor's Blessing {INNATE} superpower.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, any allied Asgard character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
This character may reroll any number of its defense dice this Round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the end of the Activation Phase, an allied The Mighty Thor may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
The Mighty Thor removes her Activated token. Then she immediately Activates.
During the next Cleanup Phase, The Mighty Thor is KO'd.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Asgard character would be damaged by an enemy effect they may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Reduce the amount of damage suffered to one.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Asgard characters that are not holding objective tokens may spend 3 {PWR} each to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} are placed within {RNG} 3 of their current location.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During an allied non-Asgard character's Activation, Loki, Prince of Lies may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an allied non-Asgard character and an enemy character. The chosen allied character gains 5 {PWR}.
This Activation Phase, if the chosen allied character Dazes or KO's the chosen enemy character, gain 1 VP after the effect is resolved. If it did not, during the Cleanup Phase, the player controlling the chosen enemy character gains 1 VP, ths chosen allied character loses all of its {PWR}, and Loki, Prince of Lies gains 1 {PWR} for each {PWR} lost this way.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any non-Hulk Avenger character within {RNG} 3 of an allied Hulk may spend up to 5 {PWR} to play this card.
The allied Hulk suffers {DMG} equal to the Power spent and gains that much {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Avengers characters may each spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} advance {S}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When you include this card in your Squad, choose 1 non-Avengers-affiliated character with a Threat Value of 3 or less in your Squad. When the chosen character is deployed, it gains the Some Assembly Required {REACTIVE} superpower.
After all characters are deployed, discard this card.

{REACTIVE} SOME ASSEMBLY REQUIRED {PWR} 0
While this character is attacking or defending, if it is within {RNG} 2 of another allied character with a Leadership ability (active or inactive), it may use this superpower. This character adds 1 die to its attack or defense roll. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Avengers characters may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} remove the Stun special condition and remove 1 {DMG}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If Black Swan is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Black Dwarf when she uses the Charge {Active} superpower, they may each spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
After the Charge movement action is resolved but before making the attack action, you may place Black Dwarf within {RNG} 1 of Black Swan.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Black Order character would be Dazed by an enemy effect, it may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
The character immediately performs an attack before gaining the Dazed token. If this attack results in the character removing damage, it is not Dazed.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If your squad does not contain Thanos, The Mad Titan, after deployment when you would normally select your Leadership ability, Corvus Glaive may play this card.

Corvus Glaive gains the following Leadership ability. It is your active Leadership ability.

{LDR} RIGHT-HAND MAN (AFFILIATION: BLACK ORDER)
When an allied Black Order character Dazes or KO's an enemy character, all other allied Black Order characters gain 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Two Black Order characters may both spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Place one of the two characters not holding an objective token within {RNG} 1 of the other character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Choose an injured allied character to play this card.
Other allied characters gain 3 {PWR}. The chosen character is KO'd.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During Cosmic Ghost Rider's Activation, any number of allied Black Order characters may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
For each {PWR} spent to play this card, roll 1 die.
For each {CRIT}, {HIT}, {WILD}, and {BLANK} in the result, Cosmic Ghost Rider deals 1 {DMG} to an enemy character within {RNG} 3 of him. For each {FAIL} and {BLOCK} in the result, Cosmic Ghost Rider suffers 1 {DMG} and gains 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Two Brotherhood of Mutants characters may both spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Place one of the two characters not holding an objective token within {RNG} 1 of the other character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If an allied Scarlet Witch has Dazed or KO'd an enemy character this round AND an allied Quicksilver has interacted with or picked up an objective token this round, Magneto may play this card.
You may remove an Activated token from Magneto.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Brotherhood of Mutants character is attacking or defending, at the end of the Modify Dice step of the attack, before the Calculate success or failure step, it may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
This Character rerolls all of their attack or defense dice, including {FAIL} results.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If Red Skull is within {RNG} 2 of another allied character with an Activated token, they may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Remove the Activated token from the allied character and roll three dice. For each {CRIT}, {WILD}, and {HIT} rolled, that character suffers 1 {DMG}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
A Cabal character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an enemy character. Allied Cabal characters may reroll any number of attack dice when attacking the chosen character this Round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Brock Rumlow may play this card.
This Round, Brock Rumlow cannot be moved by enemy or allied effects.
Additionally, for the rest of this Round, while defending, Brock Rumlow may reroll any number of his dice.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, Malekith the Accursed may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Place a Black Bifrost token within {RNG} 1 of Malekith the Accursed, then place another Black Bifrost token within {RNG} 5 of Malekith the Accursed. Once per turn, during a character's activation, while within {RNG} 1 of a Black Bifrost token, it may suffer 1 {DMG} to be placed within {RNG} 1 of another Black Bifrost token.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the start of a Convocation character's activation, it may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Place a Projection token within {RNG} 3 of this character. When measuring ranges of this character's attacks or superpowers, measure from the Projection token instead. This character does not contest objective tokens normally. Instead, the Projection token contests all objectives as if it were this character. While the Projection token is in play, this character cannot advance or be placed. Remove the Projection token during the next Cleanup Phase.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
After an attack made by an allied Convocation character is resolved, if the attack roll contained one or more {WILD} or {HIT} results, it may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
The target character and enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of it gain the Root special condition.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Choose a Convocation character. The chosen character and two other characters within {RNG} 3 of it may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Remove the Activated token from the chosen character.
During the Cleanup Phase, you may discard two Team Tactic cards. If you do, return this card to your available Team Tactic cards. This card may be played again this game.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
A Convocation character may spend 2 {PWR} during the Power Phase to play this card.

This round, when an enemy character targets an allied character with a {PHYS} attack, you may choose to change the attack's type to {MYST}.

When an allied non-Grunt character is KO'd, after the effect is resolved, you may return this card to your available Team Tactic cards. This card may be played again this game.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of Convocation characters not holding an objective token may spend 3 {PWR} each to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} are placed within {RNG} 3 of their current location.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any Convocation character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an enemy character. Allied characters may reroll any number of attack dice when making {MYST} attacks that target the chosen character this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Side 1:
{LDR} CIRCLE OF THE COSMOS
When an allied character suffers damage from an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, you may place it within {RNG} 1 of its current position.
A character may be placed by this Leadership ability only once per turn.

Side 2:
{LDR} MOONS OF MUNNOPOR
When an allied character makes a {MYST} attack against a character without an Activated token, it may reroll one of its attack dice. When an allied character without an Activated token makes a defense roll, it may reroll one of its defense dice.

If this card is included in your roster and your squad is using the Convocation affiliation, you may add this card to your squad in addition to your normal allotment of Team Tactic cards.
When you would normally pick an active Leadership ability, choose a Convocation character to play this card, and place it with one of the sides face up in your play area.
The character that played this card has the Leadership ability showing on the face-up side. This character may spend 1 {PWR} during the Power Phase to flip this card to the other side.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
{ENRG} ELEMENTAL BLAST {RNG} 5 {STR} 7 {COST} 0
{WILD} Elemental Blast: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the Incinerate, Shock, and Slow special conditions.

A Convocation character may spend 2 {PWR} during its activation to play this card.
Choose one of the following effects:
- This character may use the Elemental Blast attack listed above once this activation.
- This character may reroll 2 dice in its defense rolls this round.
- This character may use a superpower that is normally limited to once per turn a second time this activation, paying all costs as normal.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase any number of allied Criminal Syndicate characters may spend {PWR} to play this card.
If 10 or more {PWR} was spent to play this card, take the Priority token.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
After deployment is complete, an allied Elektra or allied Taskmaster may play this card.
Mark the enemy character with the highest Threat Value with a Bounty token. If the marked character is Dazed or KO'd by the character that played this card during its activation, the character that played this card immediately makes one action after the effect is resolved, and the Bounty token is removed from the marked character.
If there is a tie for the highest Threat Value, choose one of the tied characters to receive the Bounty token.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During a Criminal Syndicate character's activation, it may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
The next attack made by this character this turn adds 3 dice to its attack roll. If the attack roll contains one or more {FAIL} results, the attacking character gains the Stagger special condition at the end of its activation.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
{MYST} TWIST THE KNIFE {RNG} 5 {STR} 5 {COST} 0

If an allied character damages an enemy character with an attack during its activation, after the attack is resolved, the attacking character may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
The attacking character immediately performs the attack listed above targeting the damaged character.
This attack can only have dice added to the attack from {CRIT} results, and this character cannot modify its attack dice during this attack.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: When an allied character would Daze an enemy character, the allied character may play this card. This character gains 3 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, any number of allied Criminal Syndicate characters may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Enemy characters must be within {RNG} 2 of characters that spent {PWR} to target them with attacks this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During an allied character's Activation, it may suffer 1 {DMG} to play this card.

Choose another allied character within {RNG} 3 of the Active character. Effects of the next attack made this Turn by the Active character cannot cause it to gain {PWR}. After the attack is resolved, the chosen character gains {PWR} equal to the {DMG} dealt by the attack.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Cleanup Phase, Dormammu may spend 6 {PWR} to play this card.
Place an allied character of Threat Value 3 or less that has been KO'd this game within {RNG} 2 of Dormammu. The character is healthy and has no damage, special conditions or effects.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Defenders character may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card.
This Round, after an attack targeting this character is resolved, another allied character may make an attack targeting the attacking enemy character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
An allied Defenders character may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an objective token within {RNG} 3 of the character that played this card and place a Mystic Ward token on it. The marked objective token cannot be Interacted with, contested, or controlled this Round. If a player is currently controlling the objective token, they are no longer controlling it. Remove this token during the next Power Phase.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Doctor Strange or an allied Wong may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Place a Mystic Portal token within {RNG} 1 of the character that played this card, then place a Mystic Portal token within {RNG} 5 of the same character. At any time during a character's activation, while within {RNG} 1 of a Mystic Portal, it may spend 1 {PWR} once per turn to be placed within {RNG} 1 of another Mystic Portal.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, any number of allied Defenders characters may each spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
This Round, while a character that played this card is holding or contesting an objective token, if it would be Pushed, Advanced, or Thrown, it may suffer 1 {DMG}. If it does, it is not Pushed, Advanced, or Thrown.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Guardians of the Galaxy characters may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Each character that spent {PWR} removes all special conditions and cannot suffer special conditions this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During Agent Venom's Activation, Agent Venom may spend any amount of {PWR} to play this card. Choose a different option from the list below for each 2 {PWR} spent. Resolve each option completely before choosing the next.
- If Agent Venom is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Gamora, Agent Venom is Thrown {M}.
- If Agent Venom is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Groot, Agent Venom may remove up to 3 {DMG}.
- If Agent Venom is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Star-Lord, Agent Venom may immediately make a Full-Auto attack listed on Star-Lord's Stat Card without paying the {PWR} cost. After the attack is resolved, Agent Venom may Advance {S}.
- If Agent Venom is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Rocket Racoon and has already made an attack this Activation, Agent Venom may immediately make an attack action. Agent Venom then Advances {S}.
- If Agent Venom is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Drax the Destroyer, Agent Venom is Thrown {S} and counts as Size 3 during this collision.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Up to four Injured allied Guardians of the Galaxy characters may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} to play this card gain a Big Dumb Hero token. Characters with a Big Dumb Hero token add 1 die to their attack and defense rolls.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Guardians of the Galaxy characters may spend 1 {PWR} each to play this card.
Each character that played this card rolls 1 die. If they roll a {CRIT} or {WILD}, they may immediately either make an attack with a Power Cost of 0 or gain 2 {PWR}. If they roll a {HIT}, enemy characters within {RNG} 3 of this character holding or contesting an objective token suffer 1 {DMG}. If they roll a {BLOCK} or a {BLANK}, they may immediately advance {S}. If they roll a {FAIL}, the character and all other characters within {RNG} 2 gain the Stun special condition. Complete each character's roll in the order of your choosing before moving to the next.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, Red Skull, Master of Hydra may play this card.
Each time an allied Hydra Troopers would be KO'd this round, remove all damage from them. They are not KO'd. Then an opposing player pushes them {S} instead.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Cleanup Phase, before Victory Points are scored, an allied Hydra character may spend 8 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an enemy character within {RNG} 2 that is contesting a Secure objective token. The chosen character counts as one of your characters for contesting Secure objective tokens this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, Red Skull, Master of Hydra may spend 10 {PWR} to play this card.
Red Skyll, Master of Hydra and all characters within {RNG} 2 of him gain a Stagger token. Red Skull, Master of Hydra gains the following superpower for the rest of the game:

{INNATE} ARCANE INVIGORATION
This character may perform an additional action each activation.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Arnim Zola may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card. Choose another allied character that is Threat Value 3 or less and within {RNG} 3 of Arnim Zola. The chosen character suffers 2 {DMG}. For the rest of the game, the chosen character may use the ESP Leakage attack and gains the Unnatural Mutation superpower.

{MYST} ESP LEAKAGE {RNG} 2 {STR} 6 {COST} 1
- Before damage is dealt, the target character suffers 1 {DMG} for each {FAIL} in the defense roll.

{Innate} UNNATURAL MUTATION
When an enemy character targets this character with an attack, this character adds two dice to its defense roll unless the attacking character pays 2 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If all of the following conditions are met simultaneously, an allied Hydra character may play this card:
Johann Schmidt is not Dazed and has six or more {PWR}.
Arnim Zola is contesting a Secure objective token.
Wolfgang von Strucker is not Dazed and is within {RNG} 2 of two or more enemy characters with the Poison special condition.
Helmut Zemo has Dazed or KO'd an enemy character this round.

Place an unused character of Threat Value four or less from your roster within {RNG} 2 of this character. It is now part of your squad.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Hydra character with an active Leadership ability is KO'd, another allied character may play this card.
Choose two allied characters with Hydra or Cabal Leadership abilities. Both chosen characters' Leadership abilities become active.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If you are Securing all Secure Objective tokens, an allied Hydra character may play this card.

You gain 1 VP for every 2 Secure Objective tokens you are Securing. Additionally, each character you control gains 1 {PWR} for every 2 Secure Objective tokens you are Securing.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
An Injured Inhuman character may play this card.
All allied Inhuman characters gain one {PWR} for each allied Injured Inhuman character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Inhuman characters may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Once this round, each character that spent {PWR} to play this card may reroll any number of dice in one of their attack or defense rolls.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
An Inhuman character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an enemy character holding a Civilian token within {RNG} 3 of this character and roll 4 dice. Deal 1 {DMG} to the enemy character for each {CRIT}, {WILD}, and {HIT} rolled. If the enemy character is Dazed or KO'd by this damage, you score 2 VPs.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
After an attack made by an allied Midnight Sons character is resolved, if the attack roll contained {CRIT}, {WILD}, and {HIT} the allied character may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
The target character and enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of it gain the Stun special condition.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Midnight Sons character is modifying its attack or defense dice, it may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Change one of the allied character's attack or defense dice to any result. This effect may change {FAIL} results.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Midnight Sons characters may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Each character that spent {PWR} may immediately perform an attack with a {PWR} cost of 0.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
{LDR} CRY FOR HELP (AFFILIATION: NEW MUTANTS)
If an allied character is targeted by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved, another allied character within {RNG} 3 of it spend 1 {PWR} to use this Leadership ability. Place the character that spent {PWR} within {RNG} 1 of the targeted character.


After all characters have been deployed, an allied Illyana Rasputin may play this card.
Illyana Rasputin gains the Leadership {LDR} ability shown above. It is your active Leadership.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied character rolls dice, if the result contained no {CRIT} results, that character may play this card.
The character that played this card may reroll any number of its dice, including {FAIL} results.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
{PHYS} BACK OFF! {RNG} 3 {STR} 5 {COST} 0
- After this attack is resolved, Push the target character Away {S}.


After an attack targeting an allied New Mutants character is resolved, the targeted allied character may play this card.
Choose another allied character within {RNG} 2 of the targeted character. The chosen character immediately makes the attack shown above targeting the attacking enemy character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied New Mutants character is Dazed or KO'd, another allied New Mutants character may play this card.
All non-Dazed allied New Mutants characters gain 2 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Jim Hammond may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Each enemy character within {RNG} 3 of Jim Hammond gains the Incinerate special condition. This round, when an allied S.H.I.E.L.D. character is attacking a character with the Incinerate special condition, if the attack type is {ENRG}, add 2 dice to the attack roll.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During a S.H.I.E.L.D. character's activation, it may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Remove up to 3 {DMG} and one special condition from this character or an allied character without a Dazed token within {RNG} 3 of this character.
This card may not be included in a roster or a squad with the Medpack Team Tactic card.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Two S.H.I.E.L.D. characters may both spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
While these characters are within {RNG} 3 of each other this round, they cannot be pushed, thrown, or placed by enemy effects, and advancing enemy characters cannot place a movement tool that would overlap either allied character or a straight line drawn between them, unless the enemy characters are climbing. Characters cannot draw LOS through these characters or through a straight line drawn between them this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied S.H.I.E.L.D. character is attacking or defending, before the "Calculate Success or Failure" step of the attack (at the end of the "Modify Dice" step), it may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
The attacking and defending characters reroll all of their attack and defense dice, including {FAIL} results.
This card may not be included in a roster or a squad with the Recalibration Matrix Team Tactic card.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
{PHYS} HELICARRIER STRIKE {RNG} 5 {STR} 6 {COST} 0
- This attack ignores LOS, and the defending character does not benefit from cover.
- Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is {PHYS} or {ENRG}.
- {WILD} Scorched Earth: After this attack is resolved, other enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of the target character suffer 1 {DMG}. If the attack type was {PHYS}, the target character and other enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of the target character gain the Bleed special condition. If the attack type was {ENRG}, the target character and other enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of the target character gain the Incinerate special condition.

During its activation, and allied S.H.I.E.L.D. character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
This character may use the attack listed above once this activation.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Nick Fury may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Nick Fury gains three LMD tokens. Each time Nick Fury is targeted by an attack, shuffle the tokens and reveal one at random. If the token has an LMD on the back, you may reroll any number of the attacker's dice. If it has Nick Fury on the back, the attack continues as normal. At the end of the round, remove all LMD tokens from the character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During a S.H.I.E.L.D. character's activation, it may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose another allied character within {RNG} 3 of the character that played this card. The chosen character may advance {S}.
This card may not be included in roster or squad with the Tactical Analysis Team Tactic card.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
After Deployment, an allied Namor, the Sub-Mariner or Steve Rogers, Captain America may play this card.
The character that played this card gains the following Leadership ability:

{LDR} THE INVADERS (AFFILIATION: S.H.I.E.L.D.)
Allied characters may reroll 1 defense die.
Additionally, they can modify and reroll {FAIL} results when they are within {RNG} 2 of another allied character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
An allied S.H.I.E.L.D. character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
This character gains the Flight {INNATE} superpower this round. It immediately advances {L}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Active
Apocalypse may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card during his Activation.
Remove 2 {DMG} from Apocalypse and each other allied character within {RNG} 2 of him.

Reactive
When Apocalypse is attacking or defending, at the end of the Modify Dice step of the attack, before the Calculate Success or Failure step, he may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
The attacking and defending characters reroll all of their attack and defense dice.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, allied Sentinels characters may each spend 1 {PWR}. If at least 2 {PWR} was spent this way, you may play this card.
Until the end of this round, enemy characters do not benefit from the Stealth superpower and cannot reroll or modify defense dice. Additionally, allied characters do not require LOS to target enemy characters with attacks until the end of this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Cassandra Nova may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Until the end of this round, allied Sentinels characters within {RNG} 3 of Cassandra Nova treat {BLOCK} results as {WILD} results.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Sentinel Prime MK4 may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an allied Injured Sentinel MK4 within {RNG} 3 of Sentinel Prime MK4. The chosen character removes all {DMG}, removes all special conditions, and flips its card to the Healthy side.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied character with the Sentinel Programming {INNATE} superpower would be KO'd, it may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Roll 5 dice. For each {HIT}, {CRIT}, and {WILD} result, all other characters within {RNG} 2 of the character that played this card suffer 1 {DMG}.
Additionally, all other characters within {RNG} 2 of the character that played this card gain the Stun special condition.
The character that played this card is then KO'd.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the Activation Phase, an allied Spider-Foes character may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an enemy character. The character that played this card gains the Singular Focus {INNATE} superpower.
The character that played this card loses the Singular Focus {INNATE} superpower when the chosen character is KO'd.

{INNATE} SINGULAR FOCUS
This character adds 2 dice to its attack rolls when targeting the chosen character. When this character rolls defense dice, if the chosen character is attacking, it adds 2 dice to its defense roll.
When this character rolls defense dice, if the chosen character is not attacking, it removes 2 dice from its defense roll.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Spider-Foes character may play this card.
During this Round, each time an enemy character suffers {DMG} from an allied effect, choose up to one of the listed allied characters that is within {RNG} 2 of the enemy character. The enemy character gains the special condition shown below corresponding to the chosen allied character.
- Sandman: Slow special condition
- Vulture: Bleed special condition
- Mysterio: Hex special condition
- Otto Octavius: Stun special condition
- Electro: Shock special condition
- Kraven the Hunter: Poison special condition

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Two allied Spider-Foes characters within {RNG} 3 of each other may each play this card.
One of the characters that played this card may suffer up to 3 {DMG}. Remove {DMG} from the other character that played this card equal to the {DMG} suffered.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any allied character may play this card during the first Power Phase.
Choose an objective token. The first time a character ends a movement within {RNG} 2 of that objective token, roll 5 dice. The moving character suffers 1 {DMG} for each {CRIT}, {WILD}, or {HIT} result in the roll. If the character suffered damage, it is pushed {S}. The character's opponent resolves this push.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Spider-Foes character is targeted by an attack, if it is holding one or more objective tokens, it may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose another allied character within {RNG} 3 of the character that played this card. Move 1 objective token from the character that played this card to the chosen character. That character is now holding the objective token. This card does not allow a character to hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.
Then the character that played this card Advances {S} Away from the attacking character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any number of allied Spider-Foes characters may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Choose an enemy character. Each character that spent {PWR} may immediately perform an attack with a {PWR} cost of 0 targeting the chosen character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If Miles Morales is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Ms. Marvel (Normal), both characters may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Ms. Marvel (Normal) transforms into Ms. Marvel (Embiggened). When resolving this transformation, place Ms. Marvel (Embiggened) within {RNG} 3 instead of {RNG} 1. Then place Miles Morales within {RNG} 1 of Ms. Marvel (Embiggened).

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
M.O.D.O.K. may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose another allied character. That character may perform a move action as an additional action during its next activation this round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During a character's activation, it may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Enemies do not benefit from the Stealth superpower and this character ignores LOS when attacking this activation.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During its activation, a character may spend up to 5 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose a number of other allied characters equal to the {PWR} spent. Each chosen character gains 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If Hulk and She-Hulk are within {RNG} 2 of the same interactive terrain feature of Size 5 or less, they may spend 3 {PWR} each to play this card.
Choose Hulk or She-Hulk to throw the terrain feature {L}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When a character with a Threat Level of 6 or less would gain an activated token at the end of its activation, they may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card.
They do not gain an activated token, your turn does not end, and you must activate that character again. At the end of this character's second activation, if they are Healthy they gain a Dazed token. If they are Injured they are KO'd.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, Shadow King may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card. Choose a Secure objective token and place an Astral Incursion token on it. Enemy characters suffer 1 {DMG} when they end an Activation within {RNG} 1 of the Astral Incursion, and when they Interact with the objective token marked by the Astral Incursion.
During the next Cleanup Phase, remove all Astral Incursion tokens.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When Archangel begins a move action within {RNG} 3 of an allied Psylocke during his Activation, he may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
When Archangel ends this move, place Psylocke within {RNG} 1 of him. Psylocke may immediately perform one of her attacks that has a listed {PWR} cost of 0.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the end of a move action made during an allied character's activation, the moving character may spend {PWR} equal to its size to play this card.
The next attack made by the moving character this activation adds dice to the attack equal to its size. If the attack deals damage, after the attack is resolved, push the target character away {S}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During Steve Rogers' Activation he may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Steve Rogers and each allied character within {RNG} 3 of him may choose one of the following effects:
- Remove 1 special condition.
- Remove 1 {DMG}
- Place within {RNG} 1 of their current position.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy character declares a move action while within {RNG} 1 of an allied Ursa Major, Ursa Major may play this card.
The enemy character may spend 3 {PWR}. If they do not, they can only use the {S} movement tool when resolving this move action.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When Sam Wilson targets an enemy character that has the Flight {INNATE} superpower with an attack, he may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Sam Wilson adds 3 dice to the attack roll against that character and may reroll any number of attack dice during this attack. If this attack deals damage, the enemy character loses the Flight {INNATE} superpower until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an enemy character. Until the end of the round, other enemy characters within {RNG} 3 of the chosen character roll 1 less die on attack and defense rolls.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the Activation Phase, any character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
The character that played this card gains an Obsession token. Choose an enemy character. While the character that played this card has an Obsession token, it adds 2 dice to its attack rolls when targeting the chosen character. When the character with the Obsession token rolls defense dice, if the chosen character is attacking, add 2 dice to the defense roll. If it is not the chosen character attacking, remove 2 dice from the defense roll. The character that played this card loses the Obsession token when the chosen character is KO'd.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Punisher may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card.
Each time an enemy character is KO'd this round, this character's controlling player gains 1 VP.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If one or more allied characters would suffer a collision, they may each spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Characters that spent {PWR} do not suffer {DMG} from this collision.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy character would be Dazed or KO'd while within {RNG} 3 of an allied Mephisto, Lord of Temptation, he may play this card. The enemy character's controlling player chooses one of the following effects:
- The enemy character is not Dazed or KO'd and removes 1 {DMG}, all special conditions, and up to one Activated token from itself. Additionally, Mephisto, Lord of Temptation gains 2 Devil's Deal tokens and removes an Activated token from any allied character.
- Mephisto, Lord of Temptation removes all {DMG} and special conditions from himself and gains 3 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Thor Odinson and Beta Ray Bill may spend 1 {PWR} each to play this card.
While within {RNG} 2 of each other this Round, the characters that played this card gain the superpower shown below.

{INNATE} THE WORTHY
This character may not be Advanced, Thrown, or Placed by enemy effects. Additionally, this character adds 3 dice to all {ENRG} attacks it makes.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
After an attack made by an allied Quicksilver that damaged an enemy character holding an Asset token is resolved, Quicksilver may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Move one Asset token from the target character to Quicksilver. He picks up and is now holding that token. This card does not allow a character to hold more tokens than the crisis specifies.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Omega Red may play this card.
Remove all special conditions from this character. It removes 1 {DMG} and gains 1 {PWR} for each special condition removed in this way.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Carnage may spend 4 {PWR} during his activation to play this card.
Choose an enemy character within {RNG} 4 of Carnage. Advance the chosen character {S} toward Carnage. After the advance, Carnage may make a Symbiote Tendrils attack targeting the chosen character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, Gambit may play this card.
This round, when an enemy character within {RNG} 4 of Gambit uses an {ACTIVE} or {REACTIVE} superpower, Gambit gains 1 {PWR} after the effect is resolved.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When Shang-Chi makes an attack, during the Modify Dice step of the attack, he may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Shang-Chi may change 2 results in either the attack or defense roll to any other result.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Deadpool may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
Add a Chimichanga objective token (Asset) to the game. Deadpool is holding this token. At the end of a character's activation, if it is holding a Chimichanga token it gains 1 {PWR} and may remove 1 {DMG} or one special condition.
Any character may use the following Interact ability:
Interact (Chimichanga): Pick up the Chimichanga token.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
An allied Agent Venom and allied Peter Parker may each spend 1 {PWR} to play this card during the Power Phase.
Agent Venom gains the Spider-Sense {INNATE} superpower until the end of the round.
Peter Parker gains the Symbiotic Instincts {INNATE} superpower until the end of the round.

{INNATE} SPIDER-SENSE
When this character is defending against a {PHYS} or {ENRG} attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Any character may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
This character gains Wall Crawler until the end of the round. This character immediately advances {S}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During any Cleanup Phase, an allied Mister Sinister may play this card.

When this card is played, set it near the battlefield instead of discarding it. During each Cleanup Phase, including the one in which this card is played, Mister Sinister may move any number of Genetic Sample tokens from himself to this card.

If this card has been played, during any Power Phase, you may remove any number of Genetic Sample tokens from this card and discard it. If you do, Place an unused character from your Roster with a Threat Value equal to half the number of Genetic Samples removed (rounding down) or lower into play within {RNG} 1 of an allied Mister Sinister. The unused character gains 3 {PWR} and is now part of your Squad.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy character targets an allied character within {RNG} 3 of an allied Red Guardian with an attack, Red Guardian may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.
Place Red Guardian within {RNG} 2 of the allied character. Red Guardian becomes the target of the attack regardless of range and LOS. If Red Guardian suffers {DMG} from the attack, and is not Dazed, after the attack is resolved, throw the attacking character away from Red Guardian {S}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Johann Schmidt may spend any amount of {PWR} to play this card.
Remove all special conditions from Johann Schmidt. Then choose one non-Dazed enemy character within {RNG} 3 of Johann Schmidt for each {PWR} spent to play this card. Each chosen character gains one of the following special conditions: Hex, Root, or Incinerate.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied Psylocke flips her Stat Card to its Injured side, she may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card. Psylocke gains the superpower shown below.

{INNATE} MARK OF THE CRIMSON DAWN
At the beginning of this character's Activation and after each of its actions, this character may Place itself within {RNG} 1.

Additionally, this character gains Healing Factor [1].

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, an allied Darkstar may spend 1 {PWR} to play this card.
This round, other characters within {RNG} 3 of Darkstar roll one fewer defense dice when defending against {ENRG} attacks.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During the Power Phase, if your squad is not using the Uncanny X-Men affiliation, Gambit may play this card.
Each allied character within {RNG} 3 of Gambit gains the Stealth {INNATE} superpower until the end of the round.
{INNATE} STEALTH - Characters must be within {RNG} 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When either an allied Gamora or an allied Nebula makes an attack action, after the attack is resolved, both characters may spend 1 {PWR} each to play this card.

The character (Gamora or Nebula) that did not make the initial attack may make an attack targeting the same target character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
During Rocket Raccoon's activation, if he is within {RNG} 2 of an allied Groot, both characters may spend 2 {PWR} each to play this card.
Rocket Raccoon may immediately perform up to three Plasma Rifle attacks. Each attack must target a different enemey character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If an allied Ghost Rider is KO'd, after the effect is resolved, he may spend 4 {PWR} to play this card before he is removed from the battlefield.
Choose another allied character. Ghost Rider removes all special conditions, removes all {DMG} and Activated tokens, drops all objective tokens, and is then placed within {RNG} 1 of the chosen character. If the chosen character was Healthy, flip Ghost Rider's card to the Healthy Side. Enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of Ghost Rider then suffer the Incinerate special condition. The chosen character is KO'd.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Archangel may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card at the start of his Activation if he is overlapping a terrain feature.
This Turn, when Archangel attacks a character that is not overlapping a terrain feature or is overlapping a terrain feature of a lesser Size than the terrain feature Archangel was overlapping when this card was played, add 2 dice to the attack roll.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Mystique may play this card.
Choose an enemy character within {RNG} 4 of this character. If there are no other non-Dazed enemy characters within {RNG} 2 of the chosen character, you may advance the chosen character its Speed toward this character.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When this card is included in your Squad, if your Squad is Unaffiliated and includes Mephisto, Lord of Temptation, he may play this card.

Your Squad is now using the Legion of the Lost affiliation regardless of other affiliated characters. Mephisto, Lord of Temptation gains the following Leadership ability. It is your active Leadership.

{LDR} DAMNATION (AFFILIATION: LEGION OF THE LOST)
During the Cleanup Phase, your opponent choses 1 non-Dazed character they control without the Incinerate special condition or the Immunity [Incinerate] {INNATE} superpower. The chosen character gains 1 {PWR} and the Incinerate special condition.

Additionally, during the Cleanup Phase, choose 2 characters you control. The chosen characters gain 1 {PWR}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When two allied characters are within {RNG} 3 of the same enemy character, the allied characters may spend 1 {PWR} each to play this card.
The enemy character rolls two fewer dice on all attacks this round, to a minimum of 1.

profiles.name: DO YOU KNOW WHO I AM?

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Juggernaut may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 4 or less and within {RNG} 2 of Juggernaut, and throw it {L}.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the Activation Phase, an allied Spider-Woman may spend 2 {PWR} to play this card.

Choose an enemy character. The next time the chosen character gains an Activated token, remove an Activated token from Spider-Woman.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When an allied character with Flight begins a move action within {RNG} 2 of another allied character of an equal or smaller size during its activation, they may spend 1 {PWR} each to play this card before moving the miniature.
When the active character ends this move, place the allied character within {RNG} 1 of it. The placed character may immediately perform one of its attacks that has a listed {PWR} cost of 0.

characteristics.name: Rules

If it is Iceman's Activation, Emma Frost may play this card.
During this Activation, superpowers and attacks used by Iceman may spend {PWR} from either Iceman or Emma Frost. Attacks made by Iceman this Activation add 1 die to their attack rolls.

Additionally, during this Activation, Iceman may use superpowers on his Stat Card any number of times, even if they say they can be used only once.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
When another allied character would deal {DMG} to an enemy character with an attack, an allied Mephisto, Lord of Temptation may play this card. The enemy character's controlling player chooses one of the following effects:
- The attack does not deal {DMG} and the enemy character loses that much {PWR} instead. For the remainder of the game, Mephisto, Lord of Temptation may have up to 5 Devil's Deal tokens instead of the normal 3. Then, Mephisto, Lord of Temptation gains 2 Devil's Deal tokens.
- After the attack is resolved, Mephisto, Lord of Temptation may remove an Activated token from himself. If he does not, return this cards to your available Team Tactic cards instead of discarding it, and this card may be played again this game.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
Killmonger may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
This round, Killmonger adds two dice to his attack rolls when attacking the enemy character with the highest threat value. If Killmonger Dazes or KOs that character this round, his controlling player scores 2VPs.
If there is a tie for the highest threat value, Killmonger's controller chooses one to be affected by this card.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text:
If there are two other non dazed allied characters within {RNG} 2 of Doctor Strange, he may spend 3 {PWR} to play this card.
Choose a character within {RNG} 3 of Doctor Strange. That character gains three Obscuring Mist tokens. Each time the character is targeted by an attack, shuffle the tokens and reveal one at random. If the token has a blank on the back, you may reroll any number of the attacker's dice. If it has a silhouette, the attack continues as normal. At the end of the round, remove all Obscuring Mist tokens from the character.

characteristics.name: Rules

When an allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, an allied Elektra may play this card.
Mark the enemy character that caused the effect with a Vendetta token. The next attack made by Elektra targeting the character with the Vendetta token adds 3 dice to its attack roll. After the attack is resolved, remove the Vendetta token.

- After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 {DMG} from itself for each {DMG} dealt.

You may choose a non-active Leadership ability of an allied character in your squad that corresponds to your Squad Affiliation. A character damaged in this way drops all objective tokens it is holding. The player playing this card chooses the order in which enemy characters are affected.

- If an allied Domino is within {RNG} 2 of Deadpool, Deadpool may use the Grenade Bounce attack listed on her stat card once this activation without paying its Power cost.
- If an allied Wolverine that is holding an objective token is within {RNG} 2 of Deadpool, place one objective token held by Wolverine onto Deadpool. Deadpool is now holding the token. This Team Tactic card does not allow a character to hold more tokens than the crisis specifies.
- If an enemy Bob, Agent of Hydra is within {RNG} 2 of Deadpool, you may remove any number of Loaded tokens from it.

Your opponent chooses one of their characters. It is now holding the Dossier (Asset) objective token. If an allied Weapon X character is holding this token, its movement speed becomes {L} and it adds 2 dice to its attack rolls. Any character may use the following Interact ability:
